7Word formation

Read the sentences. Form a word from the word in capitals so that it fits the gap.

8Listening: a new facility for school

You will hear four students arguing in favour of a new facility for their school. Match each speaker (1–4) with the facility (a–e). Use each letter only once. There is one extra. Read the options first, then listen twice.

9Write an email

You have received an email from your English-speaking friend Kate.

From: Kate · Subject: New sports centre
Hi! Thanks for your last email. Guess what? Our school is going to build a new sports centre, and we can choose what to put in it. I can’t decide! What sports facilities does your school have now? Which new facility would you like to have, and why? Who do you usually do sport with?
Write soon,
Kate

Write an email to Kate. In your email, answer her three questions. Write 100–120 words. Remember the rules of letter writing.
